description: This file is a script that analyzes other TypeScript source files in the project to detect direct calls to raw window.open, enforcing the use of a safe helper. It imports several utility functions for file collection and source analysis, and exports a function to find lines where unsafe window.open calls are made. The main function orchestrates the process and reports violations.

methods.name: asPropertyAccess
methods.description: Checks if an expression is a property access expression and returns it if so.

methods.name: isRawWindowOpenCall
methods.description: Determines if a given expression is a call to 'window.open' or 'globalThis.open'.
